text.text_excerpt: Harrah's is a pretty good casino if you want to gamble, look good, and dance =) People actually dress up to come here to go to the small club located in the casino (which surprises me). We went here in the summer after going down Bourbon street that night. The place has a good selection of slot machines if your more passive in gambling. My favorite games is roulette, so I mainly stayed there I think its a $15 or $20 minimum to play. Overall, the casino is not that big. Also, cocktail waitresses do come around often please be sure to tip them. I would say its a place worth going to get away from the summer heat in New Orleans at night. Oh, be warn it smokey in there since lots of ppl smoke...

I really like this casino. It's very easy to access in the French Quarter, it's always clean, and I always have a good time, whether it's shooting craps, playing blackjack, or roulette. Given the number of times I've won and lost here, I've probably broken even over the years :). I'm not a huge gambler. I mostly come for the free drinks and the easy drink ordering on the machines. Though I definitely feel the amount of alcohol I've been getting has decreased each year that I visit... All in all, a fun place to throw some money around and waste time during the day on a NO trip.

I was only able to make it to Harrah's one night during my trip but I had a good time. I decided to hit the blackjack table and try my luck bbuuuttt no luck there lol I did the electronic blackjack table as well and won my $20 back so I'll call that a win overall! The casino itself looks a little dated but it was clean. I was in NOLA during the week so the casino was definitely not as packed as it could've been. I didn't order any drinks or anything so I cannot comment on the bar or waitress service. I'm not a huge gambler but a visit to Harrah's would definitely be on my to do list when I touch back down in the big easy again.
